subject: SF hygiene sprint: slice & prune — close-window alignment
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SF hygiene sprint: slice & prune — close-window alignment

Team —

Quick push for a small, time-boxed hygiene sprint to tighten close-window accuracy before next week's finance forecast lock. Objectives (30–90 minute work per rep):

1) Reconcile any deals with close dates >60 days out but stage = "Commit" — either move the close date to a realistic window OR move the opp to "Qualification"/"Nurture".
2) For deals without activity in 30+ days, add a reason tag (no-response / procurement / budget / technical) and set next action date or archive.
3) Confirm and correct probability on any manual commit overrides.
4) For high-dollar opps (> $100k) with ambiguous next steps, flag to me and Jordan for quick AC sync.

I've attached a short checklist and stage-mapping reference to make the sweep consistent (pipeline-slice-and-prune-checklist.xlsx, stage-mapping-reference.png). Please do the sweep today or tomorrow and update HubSpot (track changes in the Deal Notes). If you intend to move a deal to Archive/Remove, add a short rationale in the note (one-line).

Callouts:
- If you believe a deal is on-track but needs an internal approval to keep the close date, escalate to me with the HubSpot link.
- No need to reassign ownership unless the rep is leaving or unresponsive for >14 days.

Next steps: send a 1-line ack when complete with counts: "sweep done — X updated / Y archived / Z flagged".

Thanks —
Naomi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
